answer.rationale: Broadly deploy the already-confirmed shorter, lower-friction self-serve onboarding flow. It improves completion, time-to-value, early adoption, and 30-day retention, supporting sustainable qualified revenue among SMB accounts without relying on discount-acquired cohorts. Do not respond with broad promotional pricing: the prior targeted SMB discount increased signups and qualified revenue but reduced 30-day retention by 12%, a material downstream-value risk under the stated objective. This will not fully neutralize competitor price pressure, so monitor churn and qualified-revenue outcomes closely when measurement capacity returns.
